summary: Me is the new tab-bar slot that IS the user's public profile (Content/Services/Shop/About) plus a private Menu (M7) fanning out to creator dashboard, library, purchases, courses, saved, notifications, verification and settings, and it also carries the whole Create/publish wizard and the two-tick verification purchase. Backend coverage is good for the core: profile, experience, follow, paid-DM price, tips, ticks with prices/expiry/eligibility, KYC states, content create/list/delete, moderation and notifications are all live routes. The big gaps are product-rule changes, not missing plumbing: the canvas turns ticks into an upload/storage/reach tier (5 free vs 25, 1 GB vs 10 GB, '⚠ Limits are placeholders.') against a hard flat cap of 5 (src/common/creator-allowance.ts:25) and flat 2 GB storage; it reintroduces Free content against 'no free content'; and it pays for ticks from a wallet with a PIN, against Flutterwave checkout today (no wallet-debit, no PIN anywhere). New entities are needed for featured works (M34-M36), education, profile location/open-to/skills/Threads/social order, content edit-resubmit with reviewer reason, per-piece sales, month-scoped earnings, saved events/creators and course progress. The web profile (LinkedIn-style rebuild) already matches the CV direction (headline, company, experience, skills) but differs on tabs (Overview/Content/Services/Events vs Content/Services/Shop/About), adds a four-up stat row, completeness ring and creator-tools rail the canvas omits, and has no Menu, Education, Open-to or Works; location/member-since render empty because the backend has no data. Independent live defect found: the backend still forces a creator's FIRST upload to be free (content-piece.service.ts:486-490) while the web only ever sends paid, so a new creator cannot publish their first piece from the web; the web also labels all-time earnings as 'this month' and renders the LinkedIn input twice in Edit profile. Biggest risk: the tick-as-tier and pay-from-wallet decisions touch the cap, storage, ranking and the custody/CBN question at once and need rulings before any build. Note: MANIFEST missed M13, M16, M27 and M35 (included here); the board header says 'Codes run M1–M32' and '⚠ marks anything assumed', but ids run to M37.
